hints.title: Repetition Cycle Principle
hints.text: Since the second string is finite, repeating the first string must eventually cycle through matching indices in the second string.

hints.title: State Map by Index Position
hints.text: Record the count of completed s1 copies and matched s2 copies when arriving at index in s2 at the end of each s1 iteration.

hints.title: Cycle Fast-Forwarding
hints.text: When index in s2 repeats, compute period length in s1 blocks and s2 matches. Fast forward through complete remaining periods and simulate leftover repetitions.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Pigeonhole principle guarantees cycle detection within |S2| + 1 repetitions of s1.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating all n1 repetitions takes O(n1 * |s1|) which times out for n1 = 10^6.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash map of s2 indices captures periodicity in O(|S2|) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify cycle in matching pointer and calculate period analytically.
